    toc: true

  profile: "smoke"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
Sys.setenv(VALIDATION_CALIBRATION_ROOT = normalizePath(params$root, mustWork = TRUE))
source(file.path(params$root, "R", "00_paths.R"))
activate_local_lib()
source_vc("05_report_helpers.R")
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
profile <- params$profile
directions <- read_validation_table("validation_replicate_results", profile)
diagnostics <- read_validation_table("validation_diagnostics", profile)
runtime <- read_validation_table("validation_runtime_projection", profile)
calibration <- read_validation_table("validation_calibration_summary", profile)
```

# Run Overview

```{r}
overview <- diagnostics |>
  summarise(
    jobs = n(),
    successful = sum(fit_success, na.rm = TRUE),
    failed = sum(!fit_success, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_runtime_sec = median(runtime_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_boot_success_rate = median(boot_success_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    lambda_boundary_rate = mean(selected_lambda_at_path_boundary, na.rm = TRUE),
    all_zero_rate = mean(all_zero_exposure, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
kable_if_rows(overview, "Smoke run overview")
```

# Failure and Warning Classes

```{r}
failures <- diagnostics |>
  count(fit_success, error_class, sort = TRUE)
kable_if_rows(failures, "Failure/warning classification")
```

# Runtime Projection

```{r}
kable_if_rows(compact_columns(runtime, c(
  "profile", "job_type", "observed_jobs", "successful_jobs",
  "median_runtime_sec", "p90_runtime_sec",
  "production_jobs", "projected_wall_hours_8_workers"
)), "Runtime projection using observed median runtime")
```

# Calibration Snapshot

```{r}
snap <- calibration |>
  filter(is_true_null) |>
  arrange(scenario_family, n, group, direction) |>
  select(
    scenario_family, n, within_r, between_r, group, direction,
    attempted, fit_failure_rate, retention_rate,
    rejection_rate_unconditional, rejection_unconditional_lcl,
    rejection_unconditional_ucl, null_coverage
  )
kable_if_rows(snap, "Null-direction calibration snapshot")
```
